doc.title: Jerry Hey interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 2, 2023

chapter: Synths, the section and stopping playing
title: Tenor and bari rather than alto in the section
summary: Hey never uses alto in a big section, preferring tenor and baritone sax.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Reeds, mouthpieces and horns: the reed player's gear

blocks.x: Okay. Did you prefer the alto or the tenor in the Jerry Hey Horns for the most part?

Never alto. Trumpet covers alto register and tenor has more body to the sound than alto does so I rarely write alto. I mean a couple times when it was — we did trumpet and alto just like that, like only a two horn thing where it would be kind of unison sort of in the treble staff. I would do that as a special kind of sound. But basically with a big section it’s always tenor sax and bari.
